decision: Wave46 successfully collected 3000 target-free frozen-GAR trajectories and completed the matched 50/50 expert/replay hard-latent EMA training, with finite losses and healthy state effective rank, but its obsolete audit CLI flag caused a post-training process failure before representation and closed-loop metrics were written. Reuse that exact completed checkpoint and run evaluation only. Promote replay beyond seed 0 only if first-step true advantage remains positive, mean selected true advantage over decisions 2-4 and full normalized edit-distance improvement both exceed the information-matched expert-only hard-latent parent, and representation health does not collapse. Otherwise reject expert-state coverage as the primary explanation and stop scaling the present GAR planner. All deployable proposal generation and GAR selection remain target-free; target access is restricted to separately labelled evaluation metrics and any explicitly candidate-privileged diagnostic.

jobs.purpose: Recover only the missing representation audit and target-free closed-loop evaluation from the completed wave46 replay-trained checkpoint.
